package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	gin "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	binding "github.com/gin-gonic/gin/binding"
)

// scenario for shouldbindbodywith_when_single_bind_is_enough: Gin handlers that use ShouldBindBodyWith(...) even though only one body bind is observed.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.

type CreateUserRequest struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Email string `json:"email"`
}

func scenario337Positive(c *gin.Context) {
	var req CreateUserRequest
	if err := c.ShouldBindBodyWith(&req, binding.JSON); err != nil {
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	if req.Name == "" {
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "name is required"})
		return
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusCreated, gin.H{"user": req})
}
